This PR is the **answer-first** slice of [#454](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/454), stacked on [#466](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/466).

- A bare mention such as `@sepo-agent please fix this` now goes directly to `answer`; the answer agent is the first model call. Previously, a separate model first inferred whether to answer, implement, review, etc.
- Answers may recommend one appropriate command—such as `/fix-pr` or `/review`—but cannot start work themselves.
- Repositories wanting the old inference behavior can set `AGENT_TRIAGE_MODE=agent`; the default is `commands`.
- Explicit slash commands, `agent/*` labels, authorization checks, and unmentioned follow-up handling are unchanged.
- Tests and routing documentation were updated accordingly.

The routing change is in [`extract-context.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2b1e0bf54dc5f04dbe4df065c620558b5dd14b18/.agent/src/cli/extract-context.ts#L205-L229), with the answer-only boundary in [`agent-answer.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2b1e0bf54dc5f04dbe4df065c620558b5dd14b18/.github/prompts/agent-answer.md#L8-L25).

This PR intentionally does **not** add approval offers, remove implement-metadata generation, change concurrency, or optimize explicit-route startup. CI and independent reviews are green.
